title: Zero-Copy Configuration Lookup
goal: Find a configuration entry without allocating memory or looping manually.
hints: The string slice already exists inside the slice of settings.
Return an `Option<&'a str>` tied to the lifetime of the input slice to eliminate allocations.
explanation: The `zero_copy` candidate returns `Option<&'a str>`, yielding a view into memory already owned by the input slice with zero heap allocations. Returning `Option<String>` creates unnecessary clones and violates zero-copy API expectations. Returning a reference to a temporary local clone fails compilation due to dangling references.
